contentType: Original English summaries of background variants; personality prompts are original suggestions, not the published PHB tables.

feature.name: Criminal Contact
feature.description: You use a network of agents, messengers and informants to exchange intelligence. Your background otherwise uses the Criminal proficiencies and equipment.

feature.name: By Popular Demand
feature.description: Find performance work and modest or comfortable food and lodging in arenas, fighting pits or other venues for combat entertainment. Perform nightly to keep the benefit. This background grants no additional weapon proficiency.

feature.name: Guild Membership
feature.description: Your trading guild offers professional contacts, lodging, support and political influence where it has a presence. Legal support requires a credible case. Pay 5 gp monthly dues; overdue dues must be repaid to restore benefits. This variant uses navigator's tools instead of artisan's tools; a custom background can choose the alternative extra language.

feature.name: Retainers
feature.description: Three loyal commoner retainers assist with routine work. One may be a noble squire. They do not fight, accompany you into obvious danger or risk abuse; mistreatment can make them leave. They can tend your mount, carry messages and maintain equipment. With your DM, identify your knightly order and the noble who has your service.

feature.name: Bad Reputation
feature.description: Your feared reputation lets you get away with minor offenses, such as refusing an inn bill or breaking a shop door, because witnesses often hesitate to report you. In a civilized settlement, people who know your reputation may be too afraid to confront you. This is not immunity from consequences or serious crimes.
